    <script>
        function eqhoMenuRenderAccount(data) {
            var $accountZone = $('.second-nav .user-nav');
            var isLoggedIn = !!(data && data.user && data.user.public_id);

            if (!isLoggedIn) {
                $accountZone.empty().attr('hidden', 'hidden');
                $('.account-actions').removeAttr('hidden');
                return;
            }

            var initials = data.user.initials;
            var $trigger = $accountZone.find('#dropdown-button-login');

            $trigger
                .addClass('eqho-avatar')
                .attr('title', "My account")
                .attr('aria-label', "My account")
                .attr('aria-haspopup', 'true')
                .attr('aria-expanded', 'false')
                .empty();

            if (initials) {
                $trigger.append($('<span class="eqho-avatar-initials"></span>').text(initials));
            } else {
                $trigger.append($('<span class="picto-user"></span>'));
            }

            var $profileLink = $accountZone.find('#section-menu-item-profile a');
            $profileLink.contents().filter(function () { return this.nodeType === 3; }).remove();
            $profileLink.append(document.createTextNode("My account"));

            $accountZone.find('#section-menu-item-signout').addClass('eqho-menu-signout');

            $accountZone.removeAttr('hidden');
            $('.account-actions').attr('hidden', 'hidden');
        }

        function eqhoMenuCartCount() {
            return parseInt($.trim($('.shop-cart .cart-item-nb').text()), 10) || 0;
        }

        function eqhoMenuRenderCartBadge() {
            var $badge = $('.shop-cart .cart-item-nb');
            var count = eqhoMenuCartCount();

            $badge.toggleClass('is-empty', !count);

            if (count > 99) {
                $badge.text('99+');
            }

            $('.shop-cart a').prepend($('.shop-cart .picto-cart'));
        }

        function eqhoMenuSyncAccountPopin() {
            var $zone = $('.second-nav .user-nav');
            $zone.find('#dropdown-button-login').attr('aria-expanded', $zone.hasClass('open') ? 'true' : 'false');
        }

        function eqhoMenuSetPanel(isOpen) {
            $('header.eqho-menu').attr('data-menu-state', isOpen ? 'open' : 'closed');
            $('.eqho-menu-burger').attr('aria-expanded', isOpen ? 'true' : 'false');
        }

        function eqhoMenuBindSearchToggle() {
            var launcher = document.querySelector('header.eqho-menu .picto-search.modal__launcher');

            if (!launcher) {
                return;
            }

            launcher.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
                if (!$('#modalAutosuggest').hasClass('in')) {
                    return;
                }

                event.preventDefault();
                event.stopImmediatePropagation();
                $('#modalAutosuggest').modal('hide');
            }, true);

            $(document).on('click', '#modalAutosuggest', function (event) {
                if (event.target === this) {
                    $(this).modal('hide');
                }
            });
        }

        $(document).ready(function(){
            eqhoMenuBindSearchToggle();

            $('.eqho-menu-burger').on('click', function (event) {
                event.preventDefault();
                eqhoMenuSetPanel($(this).attr('aria-expanded') !== 'true');
            });

            $(document).on('keydown', function (event) {
                if (event.key === 'Escape' && $('header.eqho-menu').attr('data-menu-state') === 'open') {
                    eqhoMenuSetPanel(false);
                    $('.eqho-menu-burger').focus();
                }
            });

            $(document).on('click', function (event) {
                if (!$(event.target).closest('header.eqho-menu').length) {
                    eqhoMenuSetPanel(false);
                }
            });

            var accountZone = document.querySelector('.second-nav .user-nav');

            if (accountZone) {
                new MutationObserver(eqhoMenuSyncAccountPopin).observe(accountZone, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
            }

            $(document).on('click', '.shop-cart a', function () {
                if (eqhoMenuCartCount()) {
                    return true;
                }

                var $notification = $('.cartempty-notification');
                $notification.addClass('store-cart__notification--active');

                setTimeout(function () {
                    $notification.removeClass('store-cart__notification--active');
                }, 3000);

                return false;
            });

            $('.picto-reset').click(function(){
               $('#header-searchbox-field').val('');
               return false;
            });

            $.ajax({
                type: 'GET',
                url: "\/us-en\/ajax\/user-information?",
                cache: false,
                success: function(data) {
                    for (var selector in data.contents) {
                        if (data.contents.hasOwnProperty(selector)) {
                            $(selector).html(data.contents[selector]);
                        }
                    }

                    eqhoMenuRenderAccount(data);
                    eqhoMenuRenderCartBadge();

                    ajaxUserInformationCallback(data);
                    if (data.gtm) {
                        dataLayer.push(data.gtm);
                    }
                    if (typeof data.gtmV2 !== 'undefined' && data.gtmV2 !== '') {
                        dataLayer.push(data.gtmV2);
                    }
                    gtminit();
                },
                error: function() {
                    eqhoMenuRenderAccount(null);
                }
            });
        });
    </script>

            var $accountZone = $('.second-nav .user-nav');
            var isLoggedIn = !!(data && data.user && data.user.public_id);

            if (!isLoggedIn) {
                $accountZone.empty().attr('hidden', 'hidden');
                $('.account-actions').removeAttr('hidden');
                return;
            }

            var initials = data.user.initials;
            var $trigger = $accountZone.find('#dropdown-button-login');

            $trigger
                .addClass('eqho-avatar')
                .attr('title', "My account")
                .attr('aria-label', "My account")
                .attr('aria-haspopup', 'true')
                .attr('aria-expanded', 'false')
                .empty();

            if (initials) {
                $trigger.append($('<span class="eqho-avatar-initials"></span>').text(initials));
            } else {
                $trigger.append($('<span class="picto-user"></span>'));
            }

            var $profileLink = $accountZone.find('#section-menu-item-profile a');
            $profileLink.contents().filter(function () { return this.nodeType === 3; }).remove();
            $profileLink.append(document.createTextNode("My account"));

            $accountZone.find('#section-menu-item-signout').addClass('eqho-menu-signout');

            $accountZone.removeAttr('hidden');
            $('.account-actions').attr('hidden', 'hidden');
        }

        function eqhoMenuCartCount() {
            return parseInt($.trim($('.shop-cart .cart-item-nb').text()), 10) || 0;
        }

        function eqhoMenuRenderCartBadge() {
            var $badge = $('.shop-cart .cart-item-nb');
            var count = eqhoMenuCartCount();

            $badge.toggleClass('is-empty', !count);

            if (count > 99) {
                $badge.text('99+');
            }

            $('.shop-cart a').prepend($('.shop-cart .picto-cart'));
        }

        function eqhoMenuSyncAccountPopin() {
            var $zone = $('.second-nav .user-nav');
            $zone.find('#dropdown-button-login').attr('aria-expanded', $zone.hasClass('open') ? 'true' : 'false');
        }

        function eqhoMenuSetPanel(isOpen) {
            $('header.eqho-menu').attr('data-menu-state', isOpen ? 'open' : 'closed');
            $('.eqho-menu-burger').attr('aria-expanded', isOpen ? 'true' : 'false');
        }

        function eqhoMenuBindSearchToggle() {
            var launcher = document.querySelector('header.eqho-menu .picto-search.modal__launcher');

            if (!launcher) {
                return;
            }

            launcher.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
                if (!$('#modalAutosuggest').hasClass('in')) {
                    return;
                }

                event.preventDefault();
                event.stopImmediatePropagation();
                $('#modalAutosuggest').modal('hide');
            }, true);

            $(document).on('click', '#modalAutosuggest', function (event) {
                if (event.target === this) {
                    $(this).modal('hide');
                }
            });
        }

        $(document).ready(function(){
            eqhoMenuBindSearchToggle();

            $('.eqho-menu-burger').on('click', function (event) {
                event.preventDefault();
                eqhoMenuSetPanel($(this).attr('aria-expanded') !== 'true');
            });

            $(document).on('keydown', function (event) {
                if (event.key === 'Escape' && $('header.eqho-menu').attr('data-menu-state') === 'open') {
                    eqhoMenuSetPanel(false);
                    $('.eqho-menu-burger').focus();
                }
            });

            $(document).on('click', function (event) {
                if (!$(event.target).closest('header.eqho-menu').length) {
                    eqhoMenuSetPanel(false);
                }
            });

            var accountZone = document.querySelector('.second-nav .user-nav');

            if (accountZone) {
                new MutationObserver(eqhoMenuSyncAccountPopin).observe(accountZone, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
            }

            $(document).on('click', '.shop-cart a', function () {
                if (eqhoMenuCartCount()) {
                    return true;
                }

                var $notification = $('.cartempty-notification');
                $notification.addClass('store-cart__notification--active');

                setTimeout(function () {
                    $notification.removeClass('store-cart__notification--active');
                }, 3000);

                return false;
            });

            $('.picto-reset').click(function(){
               $('#header-searchbox-field').val('');
               return false;
            });

            $.ajax({
                type: 'GET',
                url: "\/us-en\/ajax\/user-information?",
                cache: false,
                success: function(data) {
                    for (var selector in data.contents) {
                        if (data.contents.hasOwnProperty(selector)) {
                            $(selector).html(data.contents[selector]);
                        }
                    }

                    eqhoMenuRenderAccount(data);
                    eqhoMenuRenderCartBadge();

                    ajaxUserInformationCallback(data);
                    if (data.gtm) {
                        dataLayer.push(data.gtm);
                    }
                    if (typeof data.gtmV2 !== 'undefined' && data.gtmV2 !== '') {
                        dataLayer.push(data.gtmV2);
                    }
                    gtminit();
                },
                error: function() {
                    eqhoMenuRenderAccount(null);
                }
            });
        });
    </script>

    <script>
        function eqhoMenuRenderAccount(data) {
            var $accountZone = $('.second-nav .user-nav');
            var isLoggedIn = !!(data && data.user && data.user.public_id);

            if (!isLoggedIn) {
                $accountZone.empty().attr('hidden', 'hidden');
                $('.account-actions').removeAttr('hidden');
                return;
            }

            var initials = data.user.initials;
            var $trigger = $accountZone.find('#dropdown-button-login');

            $trigger
                .addClass('eqho-avatar')
                .attr('title', "My account")
                .attr('aria-label', "My account")
                .attr('aria-haspopup', 'true')
                .attr('aria-expanded', 'false')
                .empty();

            if (initials) {
                $trigger.append($('<span class="eqho-avatar-initials"></span>').text(initials));
            } else {
                $trigger.append($('<span class="picto-user"></span>'));
            }

            var $profileLink = $accountZone.find('#section-menu-item-profile a');
            $profileLink.contents().filter(function () { return this.nodeType === 3; }).remove();
            $profileLink.append(document.createTextNode("My account"));

            $accountZone.find('#section-menu-item-signout').addClass('eqho-menu-signout');

            $accountZone.removeAttr('hidden');
            $('.account-actions').attr('hidden', 'hidden');
        }

        function eqhoMenuCartCount() {
            return parseInt($.trim($('.shop-cart .cart-item-nb').text()), 10) || 0;
        }

        function eqhoMenuRenderCartBadge() {
            var $badge = $('.shop-cart .cart-item-nb');
            var count = eqhoMenuCartCount();

            $badge.toggleClass('is-empty', !count);

            if (count > 99) {
                $badge.text('99+');
            }

            $('.shop-cart a').prepend($('.shop-cart .picto-cart'));
        }

        function eqhoMenuSyncAccountPopin() {
            var $zone = $('.second-nav .user-nav');
            $zone.find('#dropdown-button-login').attr('aria-expanded', $zone.hasClass('open') ? 'true' : 'false');
        }

        function eqhoMenuSetPanel(isOpen) {
            $('header.eqho-menu').attr('data-menu-state', isOpen ? 'open' : 'closed');
            $('.eqho-menu-burger').attr('aria-expanded', isOpen ? 'true' : 'false');
        }

        function eqhoMenuBindSearchToggle() {
            var launcher = document.querySelector('header.eqho-menu .picto-search.modal__launcher');

            if (!launcher) {
                return;
            }

            launcher.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
                if (!$('#modalAutosuggest').hasClass('in')) {
                    return;
                }

                event.preventDefault();
                event.stopImmediatePropagation();
                $('#modalAutosuggest').modal('hide');
            }, true);

            $(document).on('click', '#modalAutosuggest', function (event) {
                if (event.target === this) {
                    $(this).modal('hide');
                }
            });
        }

        $(document).ready(function(){
            eqhoMenuBindSearchToggle();

            $('.eqho-menu-burger').on('click', function (event) {
                event.preventDefault();
                eqhoMenuSetPanel($(this).attr('aria-expanded') !== 'true');
            });

            $(document).on('keydown', function (event) {
                if (event.key === 'Escape' && $('header.eqho-menu').attr('data-menu-state') === 'open') {
                    eqhoMenuSetPanel(false);
                    $('.eqho-menu-burger').focus();
                }
            });

            $(document).on('click', function (event) {
                if (!$(event.target).closest('header.eqho-menu').length) {
                    eqhoMenuSetPanel(false);
                }
            });

            var accountZone = document.querySelector('.second-nav .user-nav');

            if (accountZone) {
                new MutationObserver(eqhoMenuSyncAccountPopin).observe(accountZone, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
            }

            $(document).on('click', '.shop-cart a', function () {
                if (eqhoMenuCartCount()) {
                    return true;
                }

                var $notification = $('.cartempty-notification');
                $notification.addClass('store-cart__notification--active');

                setTimeout(function () {
                    $notification.removeClass('store-cart__notification--active');
                }, 3000);

                return false;
            });

            $('.picto-reset').click(function(){
               $('#header-searchbox-field').val('');
               return false;
            });

            $.ajax({
                type: 'GET',
                url: "\/us-en\/ajax\/user-information?",
                cache: false,
                success: function(data) {
                    for (var selector in data.contents) {
                        if (data.contents.hasOwnProperty(selector)) {
                            $(selector).html(data.contents[selector]);
                        }
                    }

                    eqhoMenuRenderAccount(data);
                    eqhoMenuRenderCartBadge();

                    ajaxUserInformationCallback(data);
                    if (data.gtm) {
                        dataLayer.push(data.gtm);
                    }
                    if (typeof data.gtmV2 !== 'undefined' && data.gtmV2 !== '') {
                        dataLayer.push(data.gtmV2);
                    }
                    gtminit();
                },
                error: function() {
                    eqhoMenuRenderAccount(null);
                }
            });
        });
    </script>

            var launcher = document.querySelector('header.eqho-menu .picto-search.modal__launcher');

            if (!launcher) {

                if (!$('#modalAutosuggest').hasClass('in')) {
                    return;

                event.preventDefault();
                event.stopImmediatePropagation();
                $('#modalAutosuggest').modal('hide');

                if (event.target === this) {
                    $(this).modal('hide');

            $('.eqho-menu-burger').on('click', function (event) {
